label: VERIFIED
extraction: Orch Change Feature: orchestrates altering an existing, working feature to new desired behavior - update its tests to the new spec, change the implementation to match, review, and gated commit. Use when behavior is not broken but should be different. Leverages orch-pipeline shared engine. Ensures behavior changes are validated through updated tests before implementation changes. Composes existing ECC commands: /feature-dev, /plan, /code-review, /build-fix, /refactor-clean, /gan-build, plus tdd-workflow skill. Adds shared size classifier and two gates on top.
